summary: Indexed linked-list node lookup. Returns the node at zero-based index a2 by walking the chain that starts at the head pointer stored in this[9] (offset 0x24), counting entries from 0. Returns 0 immediately when a2 >= the element count this[4] (offset 0x10), or when the chain is exhausted (next pointer at node offset 0xC0 becomes 0) before reaching index a2.

local_names.this: list container holding the element count at 0x10 and the head pointer at 0x24
local_names.v2: zero-based index counter over the chain
local_names.result: current node pointer as the chain is walked

operations.description: If a2 >= this[4] (element count at offset 0x10), the requested index is out of range; return 0 without touching the list
Initialize v2 = 0 and result = this[9] (head pointer at offset 0x24)
Iterate while result is non-null, incrementing v2 each pass; break as soon as v2 equals the requested index a2
Advance result to the next node pointer stored at node offset 0xC0 when the current node is not yet at index a2
Return the node reached at index a2, or 0 when the index is out of range or the chain ends before the index is reached
